mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 AM, we are seeing overcast skies and 28 degrees at City Hall under a full moon. The ISS passes overhead tonight, but you will not be able to see it due to the clouds.

Property tax bills will arrive by December 15. You can pay your first installment to the City of Verona Treasurer by January 31, either by mail, online, or at the 24/7 drop boxes located at the City Center.

We have a busy couple of days ahead! Today, enjoy live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, and pizza at Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, look forward to trivia at The Bogey Factory and Hop Haus, plus the start of ART House 360 Thursday nights.
On November 3, officers responded to a two-vehicle crash at CTH M and CTH PB, where one driver was cited for operating without required headlights and transported to a hospital.
Today's flavor of the day is Dark Chocolate Decadence. The restaurant opens today at 10:00 AM and remains open until 10:00 PM for your convenience.
